verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents an official MCP server that lets an AI assistant understand the customer schema, build audiences, and create and manage syncs. The docs give an end-to-end example: create a cart-abandoner audience, then create a sync to Braze. A REST API covers syncs, models, sources and destinations, with bearer-key auth and keys that can be scoped for AI tools. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP flow, explicit evidence of row-level customer-data querying (beyond schema and performance analysis), REST endpoints for audience creation specifically, and a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404).
